extraction_rules.inventory: Sorted local runs/*/config.json only; no nested frozen-source duplicate configurations
extraction_rules.exact: Every type(value) is int anywhere in each historical JSON is compared with every proposed seed; booleans are excluded
extraction_rules.intervals: Historical uint32 integers with seed or root anywhere in their JSON-pointer address reserve [value,min(value+1000000,2**32)); exact base matches are reported by the exact rule
extraction_rules.policy: Policy initialization seeds exceed uint32 and receive a separate exact-integer check only; they are not passed to native-reset interval logic
extraction_rules.pairing: Shared paired/control panels are represented once in seed_roster; no internal million-offset rule is applied between distinct intentionally adjacent proposed seeds

availability_limits: Only the enumerated top-level local configurations were available to this review. No remote configuration inventory, raw ledger, checkpoint, NPZ, original trajectory or unrecorded-reset history was opened. A passing receipt proves absence of collisions under these explicit local metadata rules, not universal historical freshness.
scope: Metadata-only seed/root freshness review; no array decoding, ML/simulator imports, policy initialization, inference, fitting or native physics.
